note: Independent re-judgment against RFC 9494 Section 4.2 ('If any of the routes from the peer have been marked with the NO_LLGR community, either as sent by the peer or as the result of a configured policy, they MUST NOT be retained and MUST be removed as per the normal operation of [RFC4271].') after commit 21587224da fixed the prior reconnect-during-entry defect and 3c2a055fd9 updated the LLGR config syntax in llgr-import-no-llgr.ci. grStateManager.llgrFamilyActive no longer turns false on reconnect, so onLLGREnter runs removeNoLLGR to completion on the original connection even when a successor session comes up while the entry is in flight. New tagged real-RIB positive TestRFC9494ReconnectDuringLLGREntryStillRemovesNoLLGRRoutes proves the NO_LLGR route of connection 41 is deleted after connection 42 reconnects during the held entry. All existing proofs remain intact: TestRFC9494ZeroRestartTimeRetainsThroughTheLLGRPeriod (received NO_LLGR removed while sibling survives), TestRFC9494NoLLGRSweepWithdrawsTheBestPath and TestRFC9494SweepKeepsTheBestPathWithoutNoLLGR (best-path Withdraw), TestDeleteWithCommunity and TestRFC9494_StaleRouteWithoutNoLLGRRetained (exact community matching), and test/plugin/llgr-import-no-llgr.ci (policy-added 65535:7 removed on a real daemon while unmarked control survives with LLGR_STALE). removePhysicalSource only added unresolvedNextHops.purgeByOwner on complete release.
